Method of Attack: Memory corruption vulnerability allowing arbitrary code execution via parsing maliciously crafted .CUE files
1-click remote code execution (RCE) through Tracker Miners metadata indexer automatically parsing downloaded files
Impacted Systems: Linux systems running GNOME desktop environment
Linux distributions including Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Red Hat Enterprise, SUSE Linux Enterprise
Attack Vector: Downloading a maliciously crafted .CUE file stored in ~/Downloads folder
Automatic parsing of the .CUE file by Tracker Miners via tracker-extract process
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious .CUE files downloaded and indexed by Tracker Miners
